AdapterIdentity.description: Identity of the adapter that produced the wire exchange.

AssertionOutcome.description: Result of one stable conformance assertion.

oneOf.description: The evidence satisfies the assertion.
The evidence contradicts the assertion.
The evidence cannot decide the assertion.
The assertion does not apply to this capability state.

outcome.description: Typed result rather than a boolean that would erase uncertainty.

Assessment.description: Interpretation kept separate from the wire exchange that supports it.

availability.description: Whether the capability was observed as available.

conformance.description: Whether the exchange conformed to the active profile.

Availability.description: Evidence-backed availability of the requested capability.

oneOf.description: A correlated protocol reply established implementation support.
The barrier established that no protocol reply was produced.
The exchange could not establish either state.

CapabilityId.description: One capability with semantics defined by a protocol profile.

name.description: Stable capability name inside the protocol profile.

protocol.description: Protocol family that owns the capability semantics.

Conformance.description: Conformance of the observed exchange to the active profile.

oneOf.description: All applicable assertions passed.
At least one applicable assertion failed.
The implementation did not expose the capability, so profile conformance was not tested.
Evidence was insufficient to evaluate the profile.

CorrelationId.description: Protocol-scoped correlation identity for one request-response relation.

namespace.description: Stable namespace defining how the value is interpreted.

value.description: Exact protocol value retained without imposing a numeric representation.

EnvironmentHint.description: A bounded environment observation that never establishes topology or support.

HintObservation.description: How an environment hint was retained without promoting it to capability evidence.

oneOf.description: The variable was present; its value was intentionally not retained.
A bounded non-sensitive value was retained verbatim.

PathHop.description: One explicitly declared transport or consumer hop.

ProbeContext.description: Context in which a live probe was executed.

environment_hints.description: Bounded observations useful for diagnosis but not capability claims.

topology.description: Directly evidenced or explicitly unknown topology.

transport.description: Evidence about preparation of the active transport path.

tty_endpoint.description: TTY endpoint used for both request and response.

ProtocolId.description: A protocol or standards family independent of any implementation.

name.description: Human-readable protocol name inside the namespace.

revision.description: Profile or protocol revision used by this exchange.

StopReason.description: Why the live exchange stopped collecting response bytes.

oneOf.description: Both the capability reply and its ordering barrier were observed.
The ordering barrier arrived without a capability reply.
The configured deadline elapsed.
The bounded response buffer was exhausted.
The TTY returned end-of-input.

TopologyObservation.description: Whether the real transport topology is known from direct evidence.

oneOf.description: No direct topology sensor was available.
The caller explicitly supplied an ordered path.

hops.description: Ordered hops from client to terminal consumer.

TransportEvidence.description: Transport identity and any preparation exchanges executed before the probe.

adapter.description: Adapter that transformed logical requests into wire requests.

preparation_exchanges.description: Ordered transport-owned exchanges retained for independent inspection.

readiness.description: Evidence-backed readiness of this transport path.

TransportReadiness.description: Whether a transport path was ready for an application protocol exchange.

oneOf.description: This adapter requires no preparation exchange.
A transport-owned readiness exchange completed.
Preparation did not establish readiness before its deadline.

WireEvent.description: One parsed event with its exact wire representation.

correlation.description: Correlation value recovered from the protocol response.

fields.description: Structured protocol fields retained without changing the core schema.

protocol.description: Protocol family that parsed this event, if any.

raw_base64.description: Exact event bytes encoded with standard Base64.

sequence.description: Zero-based event order in the received byte stream.

WireEventRole.description: Semantic role of a parsed wire event.

oneOf.description: Reply to the capability probe.
Reply to the ordering barrier sent after the probe.
Bytes retained as evidence but not classified by the active adapter.

WireExchange.description: Exact bytes and parsed events from one request-response exchange.

elapsed_ms.description: Monotonic elapsed time rounded to milliseconds.

logical_request_base64.description: Logical request before any transport-specific transformation.

response_base64.description: Exact bytes read before the exchange stopped, encoded with standard Base64.

wire_request_base64.description: Exact request written to the TTY after transport transformation.

description: Version-one portable receipt for a live terminal capability probe.

adapter.description: Adapter implementation that emitted and parsed the exchange.

capability.description: Capability whose semantics govern the assessment.

correlation.description: Protocol-level correlation identity when this profile defines one.

observed_at_unix_ms.description: Wall-clock observation time as milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
